extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, pre-settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Pemberton Law enquires about £37,500 to fund his client's representation in ongoing matrimonial proceedings where around £525,000 in assets is in dispute and the other side controls the liquid assets.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. We have noted the request for £37,500 in connection with ongoing matrimonial proceedings and an asset pot of approximately £525,000. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court involved, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded and your firm's costs estimate, and details of the assets in dispute and how they are held. Please also confirm your client's details and that she consents to the enquiry. A member of the team will review the information once received and come back to you.
